name: Lovecha.
source:
Main character has been dating Manami for over half a year, but it never went beyond kissing. But now her parents have gone on a long-term business trip, and she feels very insecure at home. She suggests installing security cameras in every room, including toilet and bathroom. Now protagonist can peep on his lover in various and participate in webcam intimate sessions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
